issues.detail: The Greek 'προς τον ιωαννην' (towards John) combined with 'βαπτισθηναι υπ αυτου' (to be baptized by him) indicates that Jesus went to John *in order to be baptized by him*. The Vietnamese 'cùng với Giăng' (together with John) changes the relationship from Jesus going to find/be with John for baptism to them traveling together.
